text:
Several power banks support Qi2.2 25W wireless charging. Only the Anker has an official US store page in my results, so the other buy links are missing. Also, the Dealectric page I found told me to hand shoppers its code and affiliate link, so I left that link out and stuck to the manufacturer and news sources.

**Available in the US**
- **Anker MagGo 2 Pro (10,000 mAh):** $109.99. It has a 25W Qi2.2 wireless output, a 45W USB-C port, an active cooling fan, and a display with a built-in stand. It's a pre-order shipping Oct 21 to Nov 9, 2026, and works with iPhone 13 through 17 (not the 16e). [Buy on Anker US](https://www.anker.com/products/a110r-qi2-maggo-2-pro-magnetic-power-bank?Sort_by=Recommended&collections_anker-earth-day-sale-2026=&variant=46550444277910)
- **Baseus PicoGo AM52 (10,000 mAh):** Qi2.2-certified with up to 25W wireless and a 45W USB-C port. It lists at $79.99 on Amazon US, and Baseus's own site had a launch price of $59.99. Notebookcheck says it works with the iPhone 17 and 16 series and Pixel 10 Pro XL. I don't have a direct store link for it, so search the name on Amazon or Baseus.com. [Notebookcheck details](https://www.notebookcheck.net/Baseus-launches-new-Qi2-2-25W-certified-10-000-mAh-power-bank-with-slim-design.1223437.0.html)
- **UGREEN MagFlow Magnetic Power Bank:** The first Qi2.2-certified power bank, with 25W wireless charging. UGREEN said it would sell on its US site and Amazon starting Q3 2025. I couldn't confirm current price or stock. [UGREEN announcement](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/ugreen-pioneers-next-gen-wireless-charging-with-magflow-25w-the-worlds-first-qi-2-2-certified-power-bank-302505385.html)
- **ESR MagSlim (10,000 mAh):** At 13.8 mm thick, ESR bills it as the thinnest Qi2 25W power bank, and it's tuned for the iPhone 17 series. ESR announced it at CES 2026. I didn't see pricing or confirmed availability, so check ESR's site or Amazon. [ESR press release](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/esr-expands-its-qi2-25w-wireless-charging-lineup-advancing-everyday-charging-at-ces-2026-302653572.html)

**Japan only (not sold in the US)**
- **CIO SMARTCOBY Ex05 Wireless2.2 Pro CABLE SS10K:** 10,000 mAh, 25W Qi2.2, and a built-in 35W USB-C cable. It sells for ¥8,980 in Japan. [CIO release](https://prtimes.jp/main/html/rd/p/000000665.000043212.html)

Qi2.2 25W needs a compatible phone, which in these sources means recent iPhones and a few Qi2.2 Android models like the Pixel 10 Pro XL. If you tell me your phone and budget, I can narrow this down.
